Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Houston, Texas, and had begun a left turn when the vehicle was
struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding straight through the same intersection. On arrival, the responding
officer observed moderate front-end damage to Driver 1's vehicle on the driver's side and a corresponding impact
pattern on Driver 2's vehicle, both consistent with the collision as described at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the
crash occurred just as Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses gave the same account. Scene
photographs were taken and are on file. Driver 1 reported a concussion and complained of headache and dizziness;
the injury is consistent with the forces expected from a crash of this type. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on
the policy. The officer was unable to establish with certainty where the Passenger was seated at the moment of
impact, as stateemnts varied on this point. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the officer or reported
by any party at the scene.
